card.name: Strength words before CYP inhibitor
card.fires_on: Strength words such as weak, moderate or strong (and the -ate in moderate) placed right before an enzyme inhibitor, usually a CYP enzyme. Also the word 'as' in CYP2D6 genotype notation.
